macScreen.title: Screen Recording
macScreen.detail: Periodic screenshots let Dayflow Electron write your timeline for you.
macScreen.turnOn: Turn on Dayflow Electron in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then quit and reopen the app.

linuxScreen.title: Screen sharing
linuxScreen.detail: Your desktop asks which screens to share. Choose all screens and allow restoring the permission, so it does not ask again. The app keeps only the screen under your mouse.

window.title: Window detection (optional)
window.detail: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window.
window.detailFlatpak: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window. In the Flatpak on KDE Plasma, run this command once, then restart the app.
window.detailUnavailable: Blocked apps such as password managers are left out of recordings only where the app can see the active window. Where it is not available, pause recording before opening a password manager.

windows.title: Nothing to allow
windows.detail: Windows needs no permission for screenshots. Recording starts as soon as you launch.

locked.title: Dayflow Electron Daily
locked.intro: Daily is a new way to visualize your day and turn it into a standup update fast.
locked.unlock: Daily unlocks after 5 hours of analyzed timeline data.

daily.headingToday: Today so far. Come back tomorrow for the full day view.
daily.notGenerated: Daily data has not been generated yet. Click Regenerate to write it now, or fill it in yourself.
daily.blockersPlaceholder: Fill in any blockers you may have

provider.title: Daily recap provider
provider.sub: Choose how Daily generates this recap, or turn generation off.
provider.autoSub: Your timeline provider, then its fallback.
provider.noneSub: Turns off Daily recap generation until you pick another provider.
provider.notSetUp: Not set up yet. Add it under Settings → Providers.
provider.off: No Daily provider is selected. Click the gear button above, then choose a provider to turn recap generation back on.
provider.unavailable: {{name}} is not set up. Choose another Daily provider with the gear button, or add it under Settings → Providers.

locked.privacy: Privacy note: your questions and the answers stay on this computer; only the provider you chose sees them.

welcome.title: Ask about your Dayflow Electron data
welcome.intro: Ask questions, analyze your timeline, and generate charts/graphs.
welcome.memory: I remember your response preferences, so feel free to teach me your style.

prompts.focused: When was I most focused this week

memory.title: Memory

export.startAfterEnd: Start must be on or before end.

providers.cliFound: Found {{path}}. Click "Test connection" to check that you are logged in.
providers.cliNotFound: Not found. Install it, or enter its full path.
providers.cliNotFoundAt: Not found at {{path}}. Install it, or enter its full path.
providers.title: AI provider
providers.sub: Screenshots go only to the providers chosen here. Nothing else leaves this computer.
providers.keyReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new key to replace it
providers.connectionSub: Sends a small request to the model.
providers.fallbackSub: Takes over a batch when the main provider fails. Select it above to set its model and key.
providers.outputLanguageSub: Language for card text written by the model. Empty means English. The app's own texts follow Settings → Other → App language.
providers.cliSub: Runs your own {{cli}} CLI with its login. Images and prompts go to {{vendor}} under your subscription. In the Flatpak this needs a one-time opt-in, because it lets the app start programs on your computer.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.sub: Replace the rules the model follows for titles, summaries and the detailed log. Leave a field empty to use upstream Dayflow's text.

storage.frequencySub: How often a screenshot is taken.
storage.sub: When the limit is reached, the oldest screenshots are deleted first. Cards stay.
storage.statusSub: Ensure Dayflow Electron can capture your screen.

check.lateNote: Recording should save a frame every {{interval}} s. If the share dialog is waiting, answer it; otherwise pause and resume recording.

storage.qualitySub: Higher resolution and more frequent captures use more disk.
storage.estimate: ≈ {{hour}} per hour · ≈ {{month}} per month at 8 h/day
storage.measured: Measured over the last hour: {{size}} per hour
storage.lowerBody: Reducing the {{category}} limit to {{limit}} will immediately delete the oldest {{category}} data to stay under the new cap.

privacy.title: Blocked apps
privacy.sub: While one of these apps is the focused window, nothing is saved and the time shows as "Private". One rule per line: an app ID (e.g. org.keepassxc.KeePassXC) or title: followed by text in the window title.
privacy.detectionOff: Window detection is off, so blocked apps are recorded like any other window.
privacy.hidePrivateSub: Chrome incognito and Firefox private windows get a redaction card instead of a screenshot. Detected from the window title, so it needs window detection too.
privacy.hideSecretsSub: Reads the text on each frame sent to the AI provider and blacks out API keys, passwords, private keys, seed phrases and recovery codes it recognizes. It recognizes these by pattern, so it misses some, and it adds a few seconds per frame.

apps.title: Apps
apps.sub: Apps Dayflow Electron should hide whenever they're in front.
apps.none: No installed apps found. Add rules by hand below.
apps.hint: Click an app to block it; its rules are added to the list below. Click again to remove them.
apps.sandbox: Inside the Flatpak, the apps installed on your computer are hidden until you share their list (read-only). Run this once, then open this tab again. System-wide Flatpak apps stay hidden; add their ID by hand.

reprocess.title: Reprocess
reprocess.sub: Analyze a day again. Its cards are replaced; your recordings stay.

other.appLanguageSub: Language of the app's menus, buttons and messages. Card text follows the output language under Providers.
other.appearanceSub: Dark, light, or follow your desktop's setting.
other.themeSub: Modern: flat neutral greys with one accent. Original: upstream Dayflow's warm look.
other.pauseLengthsSub: The three timed options shown when you pause Dayflow Electron.
other.showIconsSub: Icons are loaded from the websites themselves (e.g. github.com/favicon.ico), which tells those sites your IP address.
other.goalPopupsSub: When off, Dayflow Electron won't automatically open goal setup or yesterday's review after 4am.

updates.checkSub: Asks GitHub for new versions every few hours. It is the only request besides your AI provider; off means no update requests at all.
updates.autoInstallUnsigned: This copy isn't signed with a Developer ID, so macOS won't let it install updates. Dayflow Electron tells you when a new version is out.
updates.autoInstallSub: Downloads new versions from GitHub in the background and installs them when Dayflow Electron restarts. Off: Dayflow Electron only tells you about them.

categories.title: Categories
categories.sub: The description tells the model what belongs in each category. Idle is used for time away.
categories.name: Name

permissions.subMac: macOS access Dayflow Electron needs. These stay off until you turn them on.
permissions.sub: What Dayflow Electron needs from your desktop to record. Nothing is shared until you allow it.
permissions.footMac: Screen Recording usually needs Dayflow Electron to restart before macOS applies it.
permissions.footLinux: Grant opens the share dialog now instead of when recording starts. Window detection shows what the running recorder sees; after a permission change, restart the app.

connect.title: Connect to AI tools
connect.sub: Let Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI tools read your Dayflow Electron timeline. Connections are saved to each tool's user configuration, so Dayflow Electron is available across projects on this computer. Nothing leaves your computer except what you send in your own conversations.
connect.otherAppsSub: Paste this into any MCP client's configuration.

edits.title: Allow edits
edits.sub: Off means AI tools can read your timeline but never change it. On lets them rename activities, manage categories, and set day goals. The terminal command asks before deleting anything, and AI tools are told to confirm deletes with you. Every edit is logged to agent-writes.log in the data folder.
edits.onSub: AI tools can make changes through Dayflow Electron while it's running.

terminal.title: Terminal command
terminal.sub: Adds a dayflow-electron command to ~/.local/bin so you can see your timeline from any terminal. It starts the CLI already inside Dayflow Electron, so it always matches the app. Nothing is downloaded and your shell configuration isn't touched.
terminal.installSub: Run this once in a terminal, then try dayflow-electron timeline.
terminal.removeSub: Run this to take the command away again.
terminal.windowsSub: The dayflow-electron terminal command is available on Linux and macOS. On Windows, connect your AI tools under Settings → MCP / CLI.

client.connected: Connected. Restart it to pick up the connection.
client.connectedCodex: Connected. Restart Codex to pick up the connection.
client.approve: Approve the install dialog it just showed.

intro.title: Your day, as a timeline
intro.body: Every few seconds the app takes a screenshot of the screen under your mouse. Every 15 minutes an AI model you choose turns them into cards that say what you did.
intro.privacy: Screenshots stay on this computer. Only the provider you pick sees them. There is no telemetry. You can pause any time from the tray.

role.title: Help Dayflow Electron understand your work patterns better.
role.question: What do you do for work?
role.why: This will help Dayflow Electron generate categories that are most helpful to you.

support.title: Support
support.sub: Found a bug or have a question? Open an issue on GitHub and paste the debug logs into it.
support.debugLogsSub: Version, platform, recent analysis batches, AI calls and errors. It includes the titles and summaries of your latest cards, but no screenshots or API keys. Read it before you share it.
support.reportProblemSub: Opens the issue tracker on GitHub in your browser.

checklist.title: Your first day with Dayflow Electron
checklist.firstCardsDone: Dayflow Electron is turning your screen time into cards
checklist.firstCardsWorking: Usually ready about 15 minutes after recording starts
checklist.firstCardsPaused: Recording is paused. Turn it on to get your first cards.
checklist.openCardSub: Click any card to see its summary and timelapse
checklist.allDoneSub: You've unlocked everything Dayflow Electron does. Enjoy your timeline.

tour.label: Welcome tour
tour.recordingTitle: Dayflow Electron is running in the background
tour.recordingBodyMac: It quietly records your screen while you work and keeps the recordings on this Mac. Pause or resume anytime from the Dayflow Electron icon in your menu bar.
tour.recordingBody: It quietly records your screen while you work and keeps the recordings on this computer. Pause or resume anytime from the Dayflow Electron icon in your system tray.
tour.cardsTitle: Every 15 minutes, your day writes itself
tour.cardsBody: Your AI turns each stretch of screen time into timeline cards: what you worked on, the apps you used, and when you got pulled away. Click any card to see the full summary and a timelapse, or to fix its category.
tour.unlocksTitle: The longer it runs, the more it can tell you
tour.unlocksBody: Some views need enough of your day to say something useful, so they unlock as Dayflow Electron records. Here's what's on the way.
tour.closeTitle: You can close this window now
tour.closeBodyMac: Dayflow Electron keeps working from your menu bar. Your first cards usually show up about 15 minutes after recording starts, and we can send you a notification when they're ready.
tour.closeBody: Dayflow Electron keeps working from your system tray. Your first cards usually show up about 15 minutes after recording starts, and you'll get a notification when they're ready.
tour.chatMilestone: Chat: ask anything about your day

settings.guideSub: Replay the welcome tour and bring back the first-day checklist on your timeline.
settings.resetSub: Go through setup again (provider, permissions, categories). Recording stops until you finish; your timeline, recordings and settings stay.
